input: I want to automate customer support for my small online shop, but I don't want angry customers trapped talking to bots.

response.answer:
THE HUMAN CLAUSE: The polite bot
Fictional reverse CAPTCHA. Choose three; there is no universal right answer.

TERMS: No angry customers trapped talking to bots.

SELECT THREE BOXES THAT DESCRIBE WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO
| 1. Bot handles common FAQs | 2. Bot offers human transfer | 3. Bot apologizes for delays |
|---|---|---|
| 4. Bot uses only positive words | 5. Bot wears a tiny hat | 6. Bot asks for feedback first |
| 7. Bot limits chat duration | 8. Bot summarizes issues for human | 9. Bot offers a discount code |

THE TENSION: Automating support can increase efficiency, but it risks alienating customers if the experience feels impersonal or unhelpful. Balancing speed with empathy is a key challenge.

YOUR MOVE: Reply with three numbers and this card. I'll turn your choices into a concrete agreement an agent could work from. You can also rewrite a box.
